quote: It was it's the longest d1nz car at the moment ... We went to go pick it up. It was a beer shell. It had no motor
why: The 2024 D1NZ Pro Sport champion's AE86 has raced in D1NZ since 2004 and started as a bare shell from a judge. Good off-season story.
caption:
Keisuke Nagashima's D1NZ title-winning AE86 started life as a bare shell with just a roll cage, bought from a D1NZ judge. 🔧
